text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan Sistem

Insurans Pekerjaan (Perbekalan) 2024.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2024

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi empat ratus tujuh puluh

lapan juta sembilan ratus tiga puluh dua ribu ringgit (RM478,932,000)

daripada Kumpulan Wang Insurans Pekerjaan bagi perbelanjaan

untuk pentadbiran Sistem Insurans Pekerjaan bagi tahun 2024 adalah

dengan ini dibenarkan bagi maksud yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Amaun

(RM)

Emolumen 158,874,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan 147,622,000

Pemberian, bayaran tetap dan bayaran lain 13,563,000

Perbelanjaan lain 50,909,000

Harta tanah, loji dan peralatan 107,964,000

JUMLAH 478,932,000

Dibuat 7 Februari 2024

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/28/9(4); PN(PU2)747/III]

 SIM CHEE KEONG

Menteri Sumber Manusia

EMPLOYMENT INSURANCE SYSTEM ACT 2017

EMPLOYMENT INSURANCE SYSTEM (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 48(1) of the

Employment Insurance System Act 2017 [Act 800], the Minister makes

the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Employment Insurance

System (Supply) Regulations 2024.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2024

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding four hundred and seventy-eight million

nine hundred and thirty-two thousand ringgit (RM478,932,000) from

the Employment Insurance Fund for the expenditure on administration

of the Employment Insurance System for the year 2024 is hereby authorized

for the purposes specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Amount

(RM)

Emoluments 158,874,000

Supplies and services 147,622,000

Grants, fixed payments and other payments 13,563,000

Other expenditures 50,909,000

Landed properties, plants and equipment 107,964,000

TOTAL 478,932,000

Made 7 February 2024

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/28/9(4); PN(PU2)747/III]

 SIM CHEE KEONG

Minister of Human Resources
